_comment: OptionsAgent config. Hard rails live in code (harness/risk_rails.py), NOT here, so they can't be loosened by editing JSON. This file holds tunables only.
_phase_comment: Phased rollout per ARCHITECTURE.md: wheel -> spreads -> long_options -> straddles. Only strategy_types allowed for the active phase are proposed/executed.

conviction._comment: Below floor: pass, no trade. Scales linearly floor->max to size_min->size_max fraction of per-position cap.

wheel._csp_dte_min_comment: Must stay comfortably ABOVE dte_close (21): the scoring formula favors the shortest DTE in range, so a dte_min equal to dte_close would preferentially open positions the exit sweep force-closes the same day (guaranteed round-trip spread loss).

self_learning._comment: Deferred until a paper track record exists, per ARCHITECTURE.md.
